scripts.lint: biome check . && cd packages/dart && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed . && dart analyze --fatal-infos
scripts.format: biome check --write . && cd packages/dart && dart format .
scripts.check: pnpm validate && pnpm build:data && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm parity
scripts.version: changeset version && node tools/sync-version.ts && pnpm build:data
